timeline.body:
Field level security was interacting in bad ways with the can-match phase on frozen tier shards (interaction between `FieldSubsetReader` and `RewriteCachingDirectoryReader`). This made can-match phase fail, which in the normal case would result in extra load on the frozen tier, and in the extreme case (in interaction with https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/51708) made searches fail.

This is a bug that was indirectly introduced by #78988.

Closes #82044
